name: libpcap BPF compiler
description: The libpcap BPF compiler translates human-readable filter expressions into BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) bytecode. The compilation process involves a Yacc-based parser (pcap_parse) that generates an intermediate representation (icode), followed by a multi-pass optimizer (bpf_optimize) that simplifies the code. Finally, the optimized icode is converted into a flat array of BPF instructions (icode_to_fcode). The compiler is sensitive to the link-layer type (DLT), which dictates the interpretation of protocol headers and offsets in the filter expression.
